policy: All public service/location pages allow indexing at the owner’s request. Public-resource links do not imply affiliation or eligibility for every address. Shared service guidance is not claimed as unique local job history.

la.label: Los Angeles County household hazardous waste resources
la.description: For paint, chemicals, batteries, or electronics, check Los Angeles County’s household hazardous waste collection resources before adding them to a junk pickup.

oc.label: Orange County household hazardous waste resources
oc.description: Orange County provides household hazardous waste collection information for residents. Check the program before arranging disposal of paint, chemicals, batteries, or similar materials.

riverside.label: Riverside County Waste Resources
riverside.description: Riverside County Waste Resources lists household hazardous waste collection options. Check the current program and accepted materials for items that do not belong in an ordinary junk load.

sb.label: San Bernardino County household hazardous waste resources
sb.description: San Bernardino County’s household hazardous waste program provides collection guidance for materials such as paint, chemicals, and batteries. Review the program that applies to your waste before arranging disposal.

pasadena.intro: We offer furniture pickup, mixed household junk removal, and cleanouts in Pasadena. Whether you need a few pieces removed or most of a room cleared, we estimate the items that are actually going—not the size of your address.
pasadena.access: Tell us whether pickup is from a home, apartment, storage unit, or business. Include the floor, stairs or elevator, parking distance, and any gate or building arrangements. Confirm loading access with the property manager when needed.
pasadena.collection_note: Pasadena’s municipal bulky-item pickup is for City refuse customers. The city asks customers to schedule first and move items to the parkway; apartment residents with a private hauler should contact that provider. Our paid pickup can include carrying items from inside when agreed in the quote.
